But the player can only face one direction at a time, and the white bar extends in a straight line. To touch all three squares, the player would need to be in a position where all three squares are in a line, which they're not (they're at different positions).
Let me try a different approach. Maybe I need to use SPACE to extend the bar and then move while the bar is extended, creating a trail or path.
Actually, let me try moving LEFT from the current position to see if I can reach the left square and the horizontal bar.
